description:
Diable Armaaonics v.1.3.7

>>Download<<

This sub-mod that allows the use of Diable Avionics' Wanzers with the ARMAA Strikecraft system.
Become a Wanzer pilot and learn to dodge incoming fire!

Requirements:
Diable Avionics 2.9.3+ Thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=10046
(Currently compatible with both existing forks of DA)
Arma Armatura 3.15+ Thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=18751.0
(+ their respective requirements, Lazylib and Magiclib)

Changelog v1.3.5 to v1.3.7:
ver 1.3.7 (ONLY SAVE COMPATIBLE with 1.3.5 and 1.3.6)
-New balance pass
-Paintjobs added (courtesy of Bass)
-Fixes/tunings/rewrites of multiple shipsystems and their AIs (namely Frost, Hoar, Avalanche)

ver 1.3.6 (ONLY SAVE COMPATIBLE with the PREVIOUS VERSION ONLY)
-Improved the Strega sprite a little
-Adjusted the Wingcom Frost's AI to actually use its blade

ver 1.3.5 (NOT SAVE COMPATIBLE with previous versions)
-Complete rebalance of all the Wingcom Wanzers with improved usability
-Added the Strega long range sniper unit and its holo decoy custom system
-weapons all have role descriptors
-Wanzers now receive the arma ground effect bonus
-Wanzers have "properly" set weapon groups

Credits:
Karmotrine Dream for being an active dev on this project
FlashFrozen and Tartiflette for their great mod and permission
Shoi for his great mod and permission
Pep for making the original version of this and allowing people to edit his work
